title.en: An Act Creating Barrio Crispina Marcos in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte
title.orig: An Act Creating Barrio Crispina Marcos in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6223_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Palongpong, Calogoan, Sampalocan and Aracua in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, are constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the Barrio of Crispina Marcos.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
